files.abilities/xatas_whisper.yaml:
id: xatas_whisper
name: Xata's Whisper
frame: Xaku
family: xatas_whisper
helminth: false
value: 0.26
duration_seconds: 35
effect:
  kind: extra_hit
  element: void
  body_part_again: true
  triggered_by_blast_detonation: true
unmodelled:
  - "The Bullet Attractor deals no damage. Its value, redirecting enemy fire and letting a punch-through round hit twice, needs enemies that shoot back and a second target; the number is unaffected."
  - "The Void proc's reset of Sentient and Shadow Stalker damage adaptation is not modelled."
  - "The Vast Untime's +50% Void vulnerability, and its pause on this buff's timer, belong to another Xaku ability, which is not modelled."
  - "Whether a lingering field's tick (the Torid's cloud) triggers an extra hit is stated by neither wiki, so it does not here."
  - "Its own crit roll — 0% base, 1x, raised only by headshot crit chance (Covenant, a charged Concentrated Arrow) — is not modelled; with neither in the build it never crits of its own."
  - "A sneak attack on the hit is not copied onto it; the sim has no sneak attacks."
live_bugs:
  - "An extra hit also fires off a Blast detonation, taking the faction bonus a third time and the elemental bonus the detonation itself is denied. The wiki lists it as a bug; it is modelled as it plays now, and a fix would change this number."
source:
  url: https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Xata%27s_Whisper

files.benchmarks/demolisher.yaml:
id: demolisher
name: "Demolisher · one target · Demolisher Devourer {scene} · 4-player health · 180 s · KPM"
standard: "One specific fight players run, measured as it is rather than as a stand-in for most play: a Demolisher a full squad meets, taken apart by one weapon."
rules:
  - "The target is one Demolisher Devourer {scene}, carrying the health a four-player squad gives it. The fight lasts 180 seconds."
  - "ONE WEAPON FIRES. A four-player squad is a harder TARGET here, not three more guns — this fight has one shooter — so what is ranked is how much of that Demolisher your weapon alone takes off."
  - "One target: damage that reaches other enemies counts for nothing here."
  - "Every shot is aimed and every one lands on the weak point, which is worth 3x."
  - "Radiation cannot proc on this unit: the type is dropped from the draw, and every other type on the build gets likelier for it."
  - "It can never be Frozen, so Cold climbs to its cap and stays there. An Impact proc lands and counts as a status type, and does not stagger it."
  - "The score is kills per minute, counting the fraction of the current target already gone. Removing 3% of one Demolisher in 180 seconds scores 0.03 and still ranks."
  - "Every main slot is filled, every evolution tier the entry has is taken, every arcane seat it has is filled. The Exilus slot is optional: a row may wear one and a row without one is not a lesser build, so the two sit on the same board and the better number wins."
  - "The stance slot is optional too, and it is not a discount but a GRANT: a stance hands the weapon 10 mod capacity on a matching polarity, 5 on a bare slot and 4 on the wrong colour. A row without one is not a lesser build; it is a build that spent the capacity elsewhere."
  - "Investment is not ranked: every entry is scored at full Forma, at max rank, and at the maximum roll of any bonus a player can raise by farming duplicates."
  - "The reserve is not spent: every entry fires as if it were being resupplied by the squad this target was brought for, so nothing here ranks ammo economy. An entry that cannot be resupplied at all runs on its own reserve."
  - "The melee weapon is DRAWN, not quick-melee: a card that says \"With Melee Weapon Equipped\" pays here. A build swung out of a gun is a different fight and the simulator has a switch for it; the ruler does not."
  - "An entry that can be played more than one way is ranked once per way, and the way it was played is part of the row."
  - "A buff starts the fight FULL only if it is permanent — no timer, and not spent by being used. Such a buff can be held for the whole fight by anyone, so scoring it at anything less would rank how long ago the entrant last topped it up. Every other buff starts at zero and is earned in the fight. Two buffs in the data qualify today."
  - "Its nullifying pulse is not applied. The wiki describes it dispelling every Warframe ability within 6.5 m every five seconds; it does not do so in game today, and this simulation matches the game rather than the card — so Roar, Eclipse and Nourish are up here."
  - "Nobody submits a number. A submission is a BUILD, and its score is computed here by this engine under the pinned seed above, so any row can be reproduced exactly by anyone with the repo."

name: "Standard Multi Target · 5x5 at 3 m · Thrax Centurion {scene} · 180 s · KPM"
standard: "Standard means this fight is claimed to represent most play, not that it is the fight you play: a crowd of tough, unaffiliated targets, packed as close as every elemental area effect still reaches and no larger than holds them whole."
rules:
  - "The target is a formation of 25 Thrax Centurions {scene}, a 5 by 5 grid spaced 3 metres centre to centre: the smallest odd square that holds every elemental area effect around the aimed body whole, a fully grown 6 m Gas cloud included. The fight lasts 180 seconds."
  - "A weapon's own explosion wider than about 6 m, and punch-through past five bodies, are clipped by the grid on purpose: a deeper column would rank the formation rather than the weapon."
  - "The spacing decides whether splash or single-target damage wins: 3 m is where that ordering matches play, and it is the widest whole metre at which Electricity still reaches a neighbour."
  - "The target is a Thrax Centurion because a build that beats it transfers: it belongs to no faction, so no faction mod and no faction bonus reads on it; it carries Overguard, which most Warframe abilities cannot take off, so the weapon has to; it is armoured and tanky; it is immune to no element, so every proc lands; its weak points are the ordinary ones, 3x on the head and 1x elsewhere."
  - "The shooter stands at contact with the middle body of the front rank, and fires along the line that rank faces."
  - "Every shot is aimed and lands on the weak point of whatever it strikes directly, including anything it punches through. A chain hop and a damage cloud cannot be a weak point hit. A BLAST detonation can: it carries the weak-point and critical multipliers of the hit that applied the stack, out to everything its 5 m sphere reaches — measured in game (MEASUREMENTS M54)."
  - "The score is kills per minute across the whole formation, counting the fraction of each target already gone."
  - "A body that dies respawns where it stood, so the arrangement is the same at the end as at the start and the score is a rate rather than a race to the last body."

files.unmodelled/reasons.yaml:
reasons:
  blob_over_cap:
    text: "Unmeasured: a shot already over the cap (multishot over {cap}) is read as holding the pile at {cap} and waiting 1.5 s, refreshed by each later shot, so steady fire never sets it off."
  blob_crossing_cap:
    text: "Unmeasured: a shot that crosses the cap is read as setting the pile off at once for {cap} stacks, the rest lost."
  arch_gun_deployer_cooldown:
    text: "The Arch-Gun Deployer's five-minute cooldown is not modelled: in a mission the weapon is gone once its reserve runs dry; here it simply stops firing."
  companion_fires_it:
    text: "The companion fires this weapon: it picks its targets, fires when it decides, and stops while reviving or out of range. Here it fires continuously at one target, so the number is the ceiling."
  zoom_steps:
    text: "Lower zoom levels are not modelled: the scope always sits at its top level and its best buff."
  spread_not_transcribed:
    text: "This attack's spread is not in the data, so none of its shots miss. At range the number is the ceiling; at point blank it is unaffected."
  heavy_charge_share_assumed:
    text: "Assumed: the heavy attack's charge is a third of its published {published} s wind-up, the share measured on a Tonfa: {charge} s of charge, shortened only by wind-up speed, then {swing} s of swing, shortened by attack speed. This weapon's own split is unmeasured."
  spectral_dagger_orbit_and_target_assumed:
    text: "Unpublished: how long a spectral dagger orbits before it seeks (the Incarnon Form card uses a stand-in), and which enemy it seeks (here, the nearest within 15 m). Both decide how soon a kill pays; neither is measured."
  dual_daggers_heavy_unmeasured:
    text: "The heavy attack is 2x, from this weapon's infobox; the wiki's class table and stance module say 5x. Unmeasured."
  sniper_combo_miss:
    text: "A miss while scoped drops the combo counter by one. This entry cannot miss, so only its {seconds} s timer removes a stack, and the number is the ceiling."
  explosion_ignores_cover:
    text: "The blast needs no line of sight. There is no cover here, so the perk adds nothing."
  mode_is_the_aim_state:
    text: "In game this mode is entered by aiming. The sim sets the mode and Aiming separately, so read every while-aiming bonus as active whenever this mode is."
  projectile_must_be_led:
    text: "The projectile has travel time and must be led at range (wiki). Every shot here connects instantly, so against a moving target the real hit rate is lower."
  orb_bounces_off_walls:
    text: "The orb bounces off walls and the floor, and there are neither here: it drifts on at {speed} m/s, leaves a standing target behind after about three seconds, lands {open_field} of its {total} strikes and detonates out of reach. In a room it stays near its target, worth about {worth} more damage. Every number for this form reads low."
  self_stagger:
    text: "In game the blast staggers the wielder; the player has no body here, so it costs nothing."
  cluster_bomblet_co:
    text: "The bomblets take no Condition Overload: the wiki's catalog gives them a rule of their own ({row}), and the engine sets the rule per weapon. They read low by that term only."
  cluster_bomblet_stagger:
    text: "The bomblets' forced stagger on contact is not modelled; the contact hit rolls its status chance like any other."
  auto_spool_ramp:
    text: "The auto-spool ramp is not modelled: the rate is the spooled-up {rate}/s from the first shot, so a short burst is faster here than in game."
  bounce_headshot_assumed:
    text: "Assumed: a bounce lands on a weak point 50% of the time. It can headshot (wiki), but where it lands depends on geometry the sim does not model, and no rate is published."
  ricochet_terrain:
    text: "A bounce here reflects off enemies only; in game walls and the floor count too, so with cover the number reads low."
  reload_never_interrupted:
    text: "A reload is never interrupted here: in game you can fire mid-reload and keep the shells already loaded. A listed reload is a whole reload, by design."
  holstered_reload:
    text: "It reloads {pct}% of its magazine a second while holstered or deployed; it is never holstered here, so the reload is always the full one."
  bolt_corpse_ragdoll:
    text: "On a kill the body follows the bolt, damaging anyone in its path (wiki). There is no ragdoll here, so against a crowd the number reads low."
  empty_reload_is_faster:
    text: "It reloads 50% faster from an empty magazine (wiki); the engine has one reload time per weapon. The sim always empties the magazine, so the {seconds} s here is the slow reload and the number reads low."
  silent_weapon:
    text: "This weapon is silent; there is nobody to alert here, so stealth is worth nothing."
  spool_rebuilds_after_reload:
    text: "The spool rebuilds after every reload. Per the page, short pauses in burst fire keep it, so a player who taps keeps more of the rate than the sim. The spool itself is modelled."
  melee_attack_unmodelled:
    text: "Not modelled: {attacks}. Of this weapon's attacks, only the swing, the slam and the heavy slam are."
  glaive_heavy_is_a_throw:
    text: "A glaive's heavy attack is the detonation of a thrown glaive, which is its own mode (a throw, detonated), so there is no standing heavy mode and a Tennokai window converts no swing."
  glaive_bounce_count_assumed:
    text: "A glaive bounces off the bodies it cannot punch through: the body it was thrown into is its first bounce, and the last its count allows turns it for home. With no walls here, a glaive that passes every body flies its whole range and bounces off nothing. A quick throw is given the charged throw's count, the only one published, and the flight between bounces adds no time."
  glaive_bounce_explosion_assumed:
    text: "A bounce explosion (Volatile Rebound, Volatile Quick Return) takes no combo multiplier and spends no combo (wiki); whether Killing Blow or any other heavy-attack card reaches it is unpublished, and here none does. Volatile Quick Return's +3 Blast Radius is put on the bounce explosion alone."
  glaive_detonation_ends_bounces:
    text: "A detonated glaive goes off on its way out, no further than the first body it cannot pass, and makes no bounce after that one: the fight does not wait for the bounces it could still have made."
  glaive_throw_return_assumed:
    text: "How fast a thrown glaive comes back is unpublished: one left to return is taken to fly back over the same distance at its own speed, and a detonated one is in the hand at once."
  glaive_throw_animation_assumed:
    text: "A throw's own animation is unpublished: it is taken as one attack at the throw's listed rate, after the charge where there is one, and attack speed shortens it."
  glaive_throw_tennokai_unmodelled:
    text: "Tennokai on a throw is not modelled as the game has it: the window pauses while the glaive flies and only a detonation spends it."
  glaive_throw_animosity_unmodelled:
    text: "Melee Animosity counts a throw as a heavy attack that pays its bonus and spends no stack; here a throw is a light input."
  gunblade_heavy_is_a_shot:
    text: "A gunblade's heavy attack fires, which is not modelled, so there is no heavy mode and a Tennokai window converts nothing."
  melee_heavy_is_special:
    text: "This weapon's heavy attack is {what}, which is not modelled, so there is no heavy mode and a Tennokai window converts nothing."
  melee_passive_unmodelled:
    text: "Not modelled: {passive}."
  melee_heavy_unpublished:
    text: "The wiki publishes no heavy attack figure for this weapon, so there is no heavy mode."
  melee_slide_unpublished:
